notes.title: Endeavor FREE Demo
notes.notes:
FREE demo of Endeavor now available as part of Steam Next Fest!

From February 24th for one week, you can jump in and experience a taste of the challenges and triumphs that await you in Endeavor. Explore deep space, test your skills, and see if you have what it takes to conquer the unknown.

In this demo, unleash your creativity without any requirements for ship building or station building. Make sure to share your innovative creations on social media using #Endeavor! We can't wait to see what you come up with.

Download the demo now and let us know what you think. We're eager to hear your feedback.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3008810/Endeavor/

Happy gaming!
